metadata.short_desc: Send, receive and search messages across every session from the WebUI.
metadata.desc: Adds a web terminal page to AstrBot: it discovers connected groups and private chats, sends and receives messages in real time, and records both bot replies and manual sends as a complete conversation.

max_log_per_session.hint: Oldest messages are trimmed automatically; both paging and trimming use message IDs

capture_bot_messages.description: Record outgoing bot and plugin messages
capture_bot_messages.hint: When enabled the terminal shows bot replies, forming a complete conversation; when disabled only incoming messages are stored

bot_display_name.hint: Outgoing bot messages appear under this name in the terminal

convert_mention_tags.description: Turn <mention> tags in replies into real @ mentions
convert_mention_tags.hint: An LLM output like <mention id="123"/> becomes a real At segment; when off the tag is sent literally

parse_bare_at.hint: Resolves @nickname against this session's participants; unresolvable names stay as plain text

auto_discover_sessions.description: Auto-discover platform groups and friends on startup
auto_discover_sessions.hint: Fetches the bot's groups and friends once AstrBot has loaded, so sessions show up without waiting for a new message

auto_discover_include_friends.hint: Only friends with existing history become sessions, keeping the list manageable; disable to discover groups only

import_astrbot_history.hint: Reads platform_message_history (requires AstrBot's group message persistence) incrementally with a watermark, never duplicating

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.description: Send messages, search history and manage sessions.
